name: ops-dash
description: Every session with LIFE_ROLE publishes its status; the ops session's /dash pane shows plan usage, every session, a one-week calendar and the shared task list.

python.title: Python for the calendar script
python.description: Absolute path of the python that runs scripts/google_calendar_read.py. Empty: no calendar.

life_repo.title: life repo
life_repo.description: Absolute path of the repo holding scripts/google_calendar_read.py and ideas/task-review/tasks.md. Empty: no calendar and no tasks.

slack_mcp.title: Slack workspaces read through an MCP server
slack_mcp.description: workspace=server pairs, comma-separated (e.g. team-a=slack-a). Those workspaces may be read through the MCP server when 詳しく hands a Slack message to the model. Empty: --show only.

dash_layout.title: Dash layout
dash_layout.description: Empty: one column below 78 columns; from 78, usage and sessions on the left with trend beside them, then calendar and tasks across the full width. "single": always one column.

pane_columns.title: Pane width
pane_columns.description: The width, in columns, the panes of this mod ask for when they open (24 to 255; default 84). A request only: a width you dragged the dock to wins and is kept by Claude Code, and the dock is at most 45% of the terminal.

palette.title: Color overrides
palette.description: Replaces colors the panes use, as name=hex pairs, comma-separated: red, green, yellow, blue, magenta, cyan, gray, white, black (black is the text on a colored box). The defaults are Rex's Abyssal Trench theme. Example: green=#52c79a,cyan=#3fbdc9

pane_background.title: Pane background
pane_background.description: A color for the background of every pane of this mod: a hex such as #050c15, or a theme key. Set it to the color of the conversation beside the pane to make them match. Empty: the pane's own color.

threads_pane.title: Threads tab
threads_pane.description: Set to 1 to register /threads and open the threads tab at start. Empty: off. Peer replies are still recorded and numbered either way.

resident_sessions.title: Resident sessions
resident_sessions.description: Session names, comma-separated, that stay in the sessions list however long they are idle or whether or not they are running (ops always does). Others that are not in `claude agents --json`, or idle for 7 days or more, are hidden. Empty: only ops.
